# Goal

## Learning
- [ ] Core concepts understood
- [ ] Trusted resources reviewed

## Notes
- [ ] Notes written
- [ ] Cheat sheet written
- [ ] Diagram created where relevant

## Build
- [ ] Safe lab or example built
- [ ] Trade-offs and failure modes documented

## Explain
- [ ] Explain without notes
- [ ] Explain a real-world design decision

## Interview
- [ ] Complete interview simulation
- [ ] Score 8/10 or higher

## Evidence level
- [ ] Level 1 — Read
- [ ] Level 2 — Notes written
- [ ] Level 3 — Built something
- [ ] Level 4 — Can explain
- [ ] Level 5 — Passed interview
